title: C++: Hash Table
description: Implement a hash table with separate chaining for collision resolution.

steps.title: Hash Table with Chaining
steps.description: Create a template HashTable<K,V> class with a hash function, insert, get, and remove. Use a vector<list<pair<K,V>>> for buckets. Test with string keys and int values.
hints: size_t hash(const K& key) { return hash<K>{}(key) % buckets.size(); }
void insert(const K& key, const V& val) { auto& bucket = buckets[hash(key)]; ... }
